# ROLL d3506ea9 requirements_common.txt + requirements_vision.txt + requirements_torch2100_vllm.txt, for Intel XPU.
# Use with build_env.sh (constraints_xpu_core.txt + overrides_vllm_xpu_oneapi.txt + overrides_roll_numpy1.txt). Changes from ROLL:
#   torch/torchvision/torchaudio, vllm (cu130) -> XPU wheels: vLLM 0.31.0+xpu (XPU wheels exist for 0.28-0.32; 0.32 lacks
#                                  vllm.transformers_utils.configs.qwen3_5 that roll/third_party/vllm/patch_transformers.py imports)
#   transformers==5.2.0         -> whatever vLLM 0.31 allows (ROLL's nightly image also runs -U transformers; ROLL asserts >=5.2)
#   numpy<2.0a0,>=1.25          -> kept (TransferQueue 0.1.6 also needs numpy<2); every XPU vLLM wheel wants opencv>=4.13 (numpy>=2),
#                                  so overrides_roll_numpy1.txt sets opencv-python-headless 4.11.0.86 (vLLM imports cv2 only for video)
#   ray[default,cgraph]==2.48.0 -> ray[default]==2.48.0: cgraph only adds cupy-cuda12x
#   flash-attn                  -> removed (CUDA build); kernels gives flash_attention_2 on XPU through the Hub kernel
#   ./mcore_adapter             -> installed editable by build_env.sh, megatron-core 0.16.x (ROLL's main image uses core_dev_r0.16.0)
